name: flat-lava-flow
comment: Flowing lava (id 10, meta 0) on the flat-flowing-water platform, overworld: BlockFlowing.updateTick with lava's level step 2 outside the Nether (BlockFlowing.java:23-26), tickRate 30 (BlockFluid.java:187-193) and the 3-in-4 stall that draws World.rand.nextInt(4) (BlockFlowing.java:59-62), so rng_state moves every lava tick. No player: no random ticks.
